Boston Family Office Has Trimmed Schlumberger LTD (SLB) Position by $564,676 as Shares Declined; As Apple (AAPL) Shares Declined, Holder Rockshelter Capital Management Lowered Stake
May 19, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Rockshelter Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 3.62% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rockshelter Capital Management Llc sold 2,277 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 60,670 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.27M, down from 62,947 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rockshelter Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $915.74B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.36% or $0.68 during the last trading session, reaching $186.31. About 16.17 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Boston Family Office Llc decreased its stake in Schlumberger Ltd (SLB) by 7.7% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Boston Family Office Llc sold 8,428 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.39% with the market. The institutional investor held 100,985 shares of the oilfield services and equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.81 million, down from 109,413 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Boston Family Office Llc who had been investing in Schlumberger Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $102.90B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.19% or $0.14 during the last trading session, reaching $74.29. About 5.72M shares traded. Schlumberger Limited (NYSE:SLB) has declined 16.28% since May 19, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.83% the S&P500.
